turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My nephew turns ten next week and loves board games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice. Would he like something competitive where he can beat the grown-ups, or a cooperative game where everyone plays together?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a minute, my friend just walked in. Don't say anything until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you have a spare hair tie?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, have you seen my water bottle? The big green one.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's in the car from last weekend, I think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, it's probably gross by now.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just take one of mine. I've got about five.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks. Do you want to come with us tomorrow, by the way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Up to the ridge and back. Maybe four hours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Tempting, but my knees say no.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. You were picking a game for your nephew, competitive or cooperative.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Cooperative. He gets upset when he loses.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good thinking. Forbidden Island is a great one, the whole family wins or loses together.
